# Copilot instructions — Abstract Security

Full working agreement: `AGENTS.md` in this repo. Read it first.

## Always

- Ground Abstract-specific claims in the reference files; never invent an endpoint, field or schema. Label anything unverified.
- Verify before claiming success — run it, read the output.
- **A zero is a claim.** An empty result is indistinguishable from "found no problems". Prove a field exists before charting or alerting on it (`POST /v1/kql/validate`), and retry an empty result 3-5 times — the query layer intermittently returns a confident 0 for data that is there.
- Never write secrets into the repo.
- Match the conventions already in the surrounding code.
- Keep customer-facing output free of internal paths, tenant IDs and other customers.
